DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 携帯電話をなくされたご相談ですね。最後にご自身で使った場面を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to report a lost mobile phone. Could you tell me when you last used it yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昼の散歩中に写真を撮りました。帰ってから見当たらず、別の端末で位置を見たら公園の辺りが出ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 散歩で撮影後に帰宅して紛失に気づき別端末では公園付近が表示されたと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I took photos during a walk at lunchtime. I could not find it after returning home, and when I checked its location on another device, the park area appeared.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you noticed it was missing after returning from a walk where you took photos, and another device showed it near the park. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示された場所の情報も伺います。この練習用画面では、更新の時刻はどこにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will also ask about the location displayed. Where is the update time on this practice screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 地図の下に昼の時刻があります。今の時刻ではないので、いま公園にあるとは言い切れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 更新は昼で現在ではなく今の所在は断定できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is a lunchtime timestamp below the map. It is not the current time, so I cannot say for certain that it is in the park now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the update was at lunchtime, not now, so its current location cannot be established. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その時刻の表示として分けて伝えてください。地図以外に、端末の特徴を説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please describe that separately as the location shown at that time. Apart from the map, can you describe the phone's features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 白いケースで、裏に星のシールがあります。画面にはひびがありますが、電話の機種名は調べてから伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 白ケースと星シールとひびは覚え機種は資料で調べてから伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It has a white case with a star sticker on the back. The screen is cracked, but I would like to check the model name before telling you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you remember the white case, star sticker and crack, and will check the model in your records before reporting it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 特徴は伺えます。機種名が不明な所は推測せず、わかる資料があれば後で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can record those features. Please do not guess the unknown model; if you have documents identifying it, we can check them later.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 購入時の控えを家で探せます。位置の表示は消さず、更新時刻がわかるように持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 購入控えを探せ位置の画面も更新時刻が読めるまま持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can look for the purchase record at home. I brought the location screen without clearing it, so the update time can still be read.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you can look for the purchase record and brought the location screen with the update time still readable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 最後の使用時刻と表示の更新時刻は、同じだと決めずに整理しましょう。電話を探して戻った場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us organize the last-use time and location update time without assuming they are the same. Have you returned anywhere to look for the phone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通った道は見直しましたが、公園の全体は探せていません。最後に写真を撮った所と、古い位置表示を分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 道は見直したが公園全域ではなく最後の撮影場所と古い表示を別に説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I checked the route I took again, but I have not searched the entire park. I will explain the last place I took photos separately from the old location display.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you checked the route, but not the whole park, and will distinguish the last photo location from the old display. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、その二つの情報と端末の特徴で届け出の相談を続けます。資料を確認する間はこちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will continue discussing the report using those two pieces of information and the phone's features. Please wait here while we check the documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票のお受取り相談ですね。票に書かれたお名前は、ご本人様でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to collect an item using a missed-delivery notice. Is the name on the notice your own?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同居している姉の名前です。姉が出掛けているので、私が代わりに受け取れると思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 姉宛ての票で本人が外出中なので代わりに受け取れると思ったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is my older sister's name; we live together. She is out, so I came thinking I could collect it for her.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the notice is addressed to your older sister and you thought you could collect it while she was out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 代わりの受取りを希望されるのですね。この練習では、荷物の扱いと必要な確認を担当に照会します。姉の方へ連絡できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You would like to collect it on her behalf. In this exercise, we will ask the person in charge about handling the parcel and the checks required. Can you contact your sister?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 連絡はできます。姉にはまだ頼まれていないので、私が来たことと受取りの希望を先に伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 姉へ連絡できるが依頼されておらず来訪と希望をまず伝えたいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. She has not asked me to do this yet, so I would first like to tell her that I came and would like to collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you can contact your sister, but she has not requested this, so you first want to tell her about your visit and intention. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 意思の確認も必要な点として伝えましょう。票以外に、いまお持ちの確認資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us also mention that her wishes need confirming. Apart from the notice, do you have any documents available for verification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私の名前と住所がある物は持っています。姉の資料はないので、この場で必ず受け取れるとは考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の住所氏名の物はあり姉の資料はなく確実な受取と思わないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have something showing my own name and address. I do not have my sister's documents, so I will not assume that I can definitely collect it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have proof of your own name and address but no documents for your sister, and will not assume collection is guaranteed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ここでは受取可能と決めず担当の案内を待ちます。姉の方がご自分で受け取る案もありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will wait for the staff's guidance without deciding here that collection is possible. Your sister could also collect it herself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 必要な条件がそろわなければ姉に自分で相談してもらいます。再配達を頼む場合の連絡先も票で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 条件がそろわなければ姉本人に相談してもらい再配達の連絡先も票で確認したいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: If the requirements cannot be met, I will ask my sister to consult them herself. I would also like to check the notice for the contact details to request redelivery.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that if the requirements are not met, your sister will consult them herself, and you want to check the redelivery contact on the notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この練習用の票の連絡欄を見ましょう。受取りと再配達のどちらにするかは、姉の方の予定も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us look at the contact section of this practice notice. Please also check your sister's schedule before choosing collection or redelivery.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 姉の希望と予定を聞き、担当が示す条件を確認します。自分で受け取れると決めず、連絡欄も控えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 姉の希望予定と担当条件を聞き代理可能と決めず連絡欄を控えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask about my sister's wishes and schedule and check the conditions the staff give. I will not assume I can collect it myself, and I will note the contact details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask your sister's wishes and schedule, check the staff's requirements, avoid assuming proxy collection is allowed, and note the contact section. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、票の扱いを担当と確認しましょう。姉の方とご相談のうえ、決まった方法でまたお問い合わせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us check with the person in charge how to handle the notice. After discussing it with your sister, please contact us again using the method you decide on.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 以前のカード紛失について、続きのご相談でしょうか。今日わかったことを伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this a follow-up about the card you previously lost? Please tell me what you found out today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今朝、上着のポケットからカードが見つかりました。昨日は電話で紛失の相談をしましたが、見つかれば使ってよいか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ポケットから見つかり昨日電話で紛失相談をしたカードを使えるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: This morning I found the card in my jacket pocket. I called yesterday about losing it, and I want to know whether I can use it now that I have found it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can use the card found in your pocket after reporting its loss by phone yesterday. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見つかったという情報を担当へ伝えます。昨日の対応状況を確認する前に、利用できるとはお答えできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will tell the person in charge that it has been found. I cannot say it can be used until yesterday's handling status has been checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ使っていません。昨日の電話で受け取った受付の番号をメモしてあるので、見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: まだ使わず前日の受付番号のメモを見てもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not used it yet. I noted the reference number I received during yesterday's call; could you look at it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have not used it yet and ask them to look at yesterday's reference-number note. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 番号を確認資料として伺います。電話で案内された内容は、どこまで覚えていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will take the number as information for verification. How much do you remember of the guidance given over the phone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 停止の相談を進めると言われたことは覚えています。完了したかどうかは、返事を聞き取れなかったので不明です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 停止相談を進める案内は覚えるが完了返答を聞けず不明と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I remember being told they would proceed with the request to suspend it. I could not catch the reply about whether it had been completed, so I do not know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you remember they would proceed with the suspension request, but could not catch whether it was completed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 完了したとの確認がない点も担当へ伝えましょう。この練習では、番号から前の相談との対応を調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us also tell the person in charge that completion has not been confirmed. In this exercise, we will use the number to look up the handling of the earlier inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号とカードを示します。別の新しいカードを申し込んだかは、受付メモに書いていないので確認してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号とカードを見せ新カード申込みがメモになく確認してほしいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will show the number and card. My reference note does not say whether I applied for a different new card, so I would like that checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will show the number and card and want confirmation because the note does not mention a new-card application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 利用状態と新しいカードの申込みは別々に確認します。見つかったカードの扱いも、その回答を受けて伺いましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the usage status and new-card application separately. Let us also ask how to handle the recovered card after those answers arrive.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 紛失後に見つかったことと、停止完了は未確認だと伝えます。利用状態と申込みの返事がそろうまで、カードは使いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発見と停止未確認を伝え利用状態と申込みの確認がそろうまで使わないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain that it was found after being lost and that completion of the suspension is unconfirmed. I will not use the card until I have answers about both its usage status and the application.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will report finding it and the unconfirmed suspension, and will not use it until both usage status and application are checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、昨日の相談を確認する担当へつなぎます。カードの扱いについて案内を受けるまで、そのままお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will connect you to the person checking yesterday's inquiry. Please wait as you are until you receive guidance on handling the card.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お買物袋についてお困りと伺いました。いつ気づいたことなのか教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: I understand there is a problem with your shopping bag. Could you tell me when you noticed it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買った洗剤の袋を家で開けると、内側が濡れていました。容器はまだ開けていませんが、漏れたのか気になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日買った洗剤の袋の内側が濡れ未開封で漏れか気になると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I opened the bag containing the detergent I bought yesterday at home, it was wet inside. I have not opened the container yet, but I wonder whether it leaked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the bag containing yesterday's detergent was wet inside, the container is unopened, and you wonder whether it leaked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 原因はまだ判断せず、商品の状態を確認します。袋の中に、ほかの物も一緒に入れていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check the product's condition without deciding the cause yet. Were there any other items in the bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 洗剤と台所用のスポンジだけです。水の入った物はありませんでしたが、洗剤が原因とまではわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 洗剤とスポンジだけで水入り品はないが原因は断定できないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only the detergent and a kitchen sponge. There was nothing containing water, but I still do not know whether the detergent caused it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that it held only detergent and a sponge, with no water-containing item, but you cannot establish the cause. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その組合せを担当に伝えます。購入の記録は紙のレシートか、ほかの方法で確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the person in charge about that combination. Can you confirm the purchase with a paper receipt or another method?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 紙のレシートは見つかりません。練習用の購入履歴画面に昨日の品名があるので、見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紙のレシートはなく練習画面に昨日の品名があるので確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I cannot find the paper receipt. Yesterday's product name appears on the practice purchase-history screen; could you look at it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have no paper receipt and ask them to check yesterday's item on the practice screen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 履歴の情報を担当へ見せて、確認に使えるか尋ねましょう。ここで交換できるとは先にお約束しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us show the history to the person in charge and ask whether it can be used for verification. I cannot promise an exchange here in advance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認をお願いします。ふたを開けて調べたりせず、濡れた袋と容器をそのまま持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認を頼み開けて調べず濡れた袋と容器をそのまま持参したと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please check it. I did not open the lid to investigate; I brought the wet bag and container just as they were.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for verification and say that you brought the wet bag and container unchanged without opening them to investigate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらで状態を確認する担当に引き継ぎます。スポンジも同じ袋にあったことがわかるようにしておけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will hand this over to the person who checks the condition. Can you also make it clear that the sponge was in the same bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: スポンジも一緒に示します。未開封と気づいた時刻、袋の中身、購入履歴を伝え、確認結果を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: スポンジも示し未開封と発見時刻と同梱品と履歴を伝えて結果を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the sponge as well. I will explain that it is unopened, when I noticed the wetness, the bag's contents and the purchase history, then wait for the result.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will also show the sponge, report the unopened state, discovery time, contents and purchase history, and wait for the result. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、状態と履歴を確認します。ご案内までお待ちください。返事がそろいましたらまたお声掛けします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will check the condition and history. Please wait for guidance. We will speak to you again when we have all the answers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 犬を連れて散歩中ですね。休憩場所の案内をご覧になっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are walking your dog. Are you looking at the information about resting places?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 少し休みたいのですが、犬と一緒に行ける場所を確かめたいです。屋根付きの休憩所まで通れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 犬連れで屋根付き休憩所へ行けるか先に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like a short rest, but I want to check where I can go with my dog. Can we get through to the covered rest area?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you first want to check whether you can reach the covered rest area with your dog. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習用の表示では、区域ごとに犬を連れての利用案内があります。休憩所へ入る前に、そちらの欄を読みましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This practice sign gives guidance on using each area with dogs. Let us read that section before entering the rest area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 犬の欄を見ます。休憩所には人が多いので、入れる場合でも別の所で待つことを考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 犬の表示を読み入れる場合も人が多ければ別の所で待ちたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will look at the dog section. There are many people in the rest area, so even if dogs are allowed, I would like to consider waiting elsewhere.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will read the dog guidance and, even if entry is allowed, would like to wait elsewhere if it is crowded. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 人が集まっていない場所を選ぶ案ですね。図の外周の道には、休憩所を通らず戻れる線があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You are considering a place without a crowd. The map shows a route around the perimeter that lets you return without going through the rest area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 外周の道へ変えたいです。そこで座る場所を探すより、入口へ戻って短く休める所を確認してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 外周を選びそこで席を探すより入口へ戻り短く休む所を確認したいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to switch to the perimeter path. Rather than look for a seat there, may I return to the entrance and check somewhere for a short rest?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you choose the perimeter and want to return to the entrance to check a short-rest spot instead of looking for a seat there. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 入口側の案内も確認できます。人がいる所を通るときは、犬と人の間隔を見ながら進んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can also check the guidance near the entrance. When passing people, please watch the distance between them and your dog.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 近くに人が来たら間隔を取ります。入口側でも利用できる所が不明なら、空いている場所へ勝手に入らず係へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 人との間隔を取り入口側でも不明な空間へ勝手に入らず係へ聞くと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will keep some distance if someone comes near. If I am unsure where we may go near the entrance too, I will ask staff instead of entering an empty space on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep distance from people and ask staff rather than enter an unclear space near the entrance without permission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 表示と現地の案内を照らしてお尋ねください。今の場所から外周へ出る方向も図で見ておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask after comparing the signs with the guidance on site. Let us also check the map for the direction from here to the perimeter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 外周へ出る方向と犬の利用表示を確認して、入口側へ戻ります。休憩先は混み具合と案内を見て決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 外周の方向と犬の表示を確認し入口へ戻って混雑と案内で休憩を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the direction to the perimeter and the dog-use signs, then return towards the entrance. I will choose a rest spot based on the crowding and guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the perimeter direction and dog signs, return to the entrance, and choose a rest spot according to crowding and guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、図と表示を確認しながらどうぞ。それでは、犬とご一緒にゆっくりお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please follow the map and signs. Take your time returning with your dog.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご乗車の予定日と行き先を確認いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let me confirm your planned travel date and destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 金曜の夜に用事が終わってから帰ります。でも遅くなるので、切符の日付を迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 金曜夜の用事後に帰るが遅くなり切符日付を迷うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will return after my plans finish on Friday night. But it will be late, so I am unsure which date the ticket should have.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you will return after Friday night's plans, but are unsure of the ticket date because it will be late. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 実際に乗る日時を確認する必要があります。用事が終わる見込みはわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check the actual date and time you will board. Do you know when your plans are likely to finish?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 深夜になるかもしれません。金曜と言えば全部同じ日付になると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 深夜の可能性があり金曜扱いと思っていたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It might be after midnight. I thought saying Friday meant everything would have the same date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that it may be after midnight and you had assumed it counted as Friday. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 日付が変わることも考えて、利用できる列車と切符を別に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Considering that the date may change, let us check available trains and tickets separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その時間に帰れる列車があるかを先に知りたいです。なければ翌朝も考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: その時刻の列車を先に調べ列車がなければ翌朝も考えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I first want to know whether there is a train home at that time. If not, I will also consider the next morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will first check trains at that time and consider the next morning if none run. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 運行する時間は最新の案内で確認してください。ここで深夜の便があるとはお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the latest information for operating times. I cannot promise here that there is a service after midnight.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 帰る時刻を決めてから、日付を確かめて買うのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰る時刻を決めて日付を確認してから買うと確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I should decide when to return, then confirm the date before buying?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will decide the return time and check the date before buying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予定が決まるまでは、日付だけを推測して購入しないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Until your plans are settled, please do not buy a ticket by guessing the date alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 用事の終了時刻を確認して、金曜夜か土曜朝かを決めたうえで切符を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 終了時刻を確認し金曜夜か土曜朝を決めて切符相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check when my plans finish, decide between Friday night and Saturday morning, then ask about a ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will confirm the finish time, decide Friday night or Saturday morning, then ask about tickets. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 乗る日時を整理できましたら、改めて窓口で確認しましょう。夜のお出かけでは時間に余裕を持ってお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Once you have sorted out your boarding date and time, let us check again at the counter. Please allow plenty of time for your journey home at night.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 返信用の欄をお持ちですが、元の通知はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have brought the reply section, but do you have the original notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先に切り離してしまいました。この紙だけで何を答えるのかわからなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 返信欄を先に切り離し答える内容が不明になったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I detached it first. Now I cannot tell what I am supposed to answer from this sheet alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you detached the reply section first and no longer know what to answer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 元の通知と合わせて確認できると、用件を整理しやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Checking it together with the original notice will make it easier to understand the purpose.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 残りの紙は鞄にあります。表題の部分も一緒に出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 鞄にある表題部分も一緒に出すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The rest of the paper is in my bag. I will take out the heading section too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will also take out the heading section from your bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つが対応するか、通知の番号などを担当者に確認してもらいましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us have the person in charge check the notice number and other details to see whether the two match.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 勝手につなげて書かず、同じ通知のものか見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同一通知の紙かを記入前に照合してほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like them to check whether these belong to the same notice, rather than joining them up and filling them in myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the sheets to be matched to the same notice before filling them in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 用件と返信先も確認します。期限が書かれた箇所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will also check the purpose and reply address. Is there a section showing a deadline?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 切り離した部分にはありません。残りの紙の小さい字を一緒に読んでもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返信欄には期限がなく残紙の小字を一緒に読むよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is none on the detached part. Could you read the small print on the remaining paper with me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the reply section has no deadline and ask them to read the small print on the remaining paper with you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 内容を確認して、担当窓口へご案内します。個別の回答方法はそこでご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the content and direct you to the responsible counter. Please discuss the specific way to reply there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二枚をまとめて示し、用件と期限と返信方法を確認してから書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二枚を示して用件期限返信方法を聞いてから記入すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show both sheets together and fill them in only after confirming the purpose, deadline and reply method.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will show both sheets and ask about the purpose, deadline and reply method before writing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 紙を重ねずに担当者が見比べられるようお持ちください。ご案内先で確認できますので、私はここで失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please carry the sheets without stacking them so the staff can compare them. You can check at the counter we direct you to; I will leave you here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初診の受付ですね。症状が始まった時期を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is your first-visit registration. Please tell me when your symptoms began.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日ここに来ると決めました。何を持ってくればよいかも知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 今日来院を決めたと答え必要な持ち物も聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I decided to come here today. I would also like to know what I should bring.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you decided to visit today and also want to ask what to bring. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 来院を決めた日ではなく、体の不調が始まった時期を伺っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I am asking when your physical symptoms began, rather than the day you decided to visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 聞き違えました。腰が痛くなったのは三日前で、来ると決めたのは今日です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 腰痛は三日前からで受診決定は今日と区別して説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I misunderstood. My lower back started hurting three days ago; I decided to come today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain separately that the lower-back pain started three days ago and the decision to seek care was today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つの時期を分けてお伝えいただきありがとうございます。持参した書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you for distinguishing those two times. Have you brought any documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 以前別の病院でもらった紙があります。ここでは初めてですが、その紙も見せるべきでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他院の書類を持参し初診時に見せるべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a paper I received at another hospital before. It is my first time here; should I show that paper too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you brought another hospital's document and ask whether to show it on the first visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 医療スタッフが必要な情報を確認します。受付に使う書類とは別に扱う場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The medical staff will check the information they need. It may be handled separately from registration documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 診察の資料と受付の持ち物を分けて相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 診療資料と受付用持ち物を別に相談したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to ask separately about consultation records and the things needed for registration.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to discuss medical records separately from items for registration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当者が順に確認しますので、今はお持ちの紙を一か所にまとめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will check them in order, so please gather the papers you have in one place for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 症状は三日前からだと伝え、紙をそろえて受付方法を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 症状の開始時期を伝え持参紙をそろえて受付方法を聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain that the symptoms started three days ago, gather the papers and ask about registration.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will report when symptoms began, gather your papers and ask how to register. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 症状と書類の確認先へご案内します。お荷物を持ってゆっくりお進みください。私は受付の案内へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will direct you to the place that checks symptoms and documents. Please take your belongings and proceed slowly. I will return to the registration information desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 拾った鍵について、見つけた状況を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me the circumstances in which you found the key.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 数字の付いた鍵を拾いました。近くの設備のものかと思いましたが、試していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 番号付き鍵を拾い設備の鍵かと思ったが試していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I picked up a key with a number on it. I thought it might belong to nearby equipment, but I did not try it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you found a numbered key and thought it might be for equipment, but did not test it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 鍵の持ち主や用途はわかりませんので、どこで拾ったか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We do not know the owner or purpose of the key, so please tell me where you found it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駐輪場の外の通路です。朝九時ごろ、地面に落ちていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 駐輪場外の通路で朝九時ごろ地面から拾ったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: On the path outside the bicycle parking area. It was on the ground at around nine this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you picked it up from the ground on the path outside the bicycle parking area around nine in the morning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 鍵にはほかに付いているものがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Is anything else attached to the key?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小さい青い札があります。数字は札に書かれていて、鍵自体には見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 青い札に数字があり鍵本体には見当たらないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is a small blue tag. The number is written on the tag; I cannot see one on the key itself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the number is on a blue tag and you cannot see one on the key itself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 札と鍵を一緒に確認します。そのまま外さずお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the tag and key together. Please hand them over without detaching them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 札を外していません。どの設備の鍵か調べようとしなくてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 札を外さず用途を自分で試していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not removed the tag. I am glad I did not try to find out which equipment it belonged to.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have not detached the tag or tried the key yourself to establish its purpose. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: わからない用途は推測せず、発見状況をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please describe how you found it without guessing its unknown purpose.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 鍵と札を一緒に渡します。駐輪場の入口ではなく外の通路で拾ったと説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 鍵札を一緒に渡し駐輪場入口ではなく外通路だと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will hand over the key and tag together. I will explain that I found it on the outside path, not at the bicycle parking entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over the key and tag together and clarify that it was on the outside path, not the bicycle parking entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 場所の違いも確認できました。お届けいただきありがとうございます。お帰りの道もお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have also confirmed that distinction in location. Thank you for bringing it in. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居の申込みで、気になっていることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you are concerned about with the change-of-address application?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ここで手続きをすれば、ネットで買う荷物も全部新しい家へ届くのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 郵便申込でネット購入荷物もすべて新居へ届くか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: If I complete the procedure here, will all the parcels I buy online also arrive at my new home?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the postal application will make all online-shopping parcels arrive at the new address too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 郵便の手続きと、ほかの配送会社や注文先の登録は分けて確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You need to check postal procedures separately from address registrations with other delivery companies and sellers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 注文の会社へも住所変更を伝えるんですね。今届く予定の荷物は、どの会社か見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 注文会社にも伝える必要を理解し配送会社は未確認と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I need to tell the company I ordered from about my address change too. I have not checked which company is delivering the parcel due to arrive now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you understand you must also inform the seller, and have not checked the delivery company. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 配送の案内で会社名や発送状況を確認し、該当する窓口へ相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Check the company name and dispatch status in the delivery information, then contact the relevant counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 発送済みなら、注文先の住所を変えるだけでは足りないかもしれませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発送後は注文先住所変更だけで足りない可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: If it has already been sent, just changing my address with the seller might not be enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that changing the seller's registered address alone may not be enough after dispatch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: すでに発送された荷物の扱いは、その配送会社の担当に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please ask the relevant delivery company's staff how to handle a parcel that has already been sent.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 郵便の申込みと、発送済みの荷物の相談を別々に進めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 郵便転居申込と発送済み荷物の対応を別々にしたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to proceed separately with the postal application and the inquiry about the dispatched parcel.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to handle the postal change-of-address application separately from the dispatched parcel. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当するところを分けて、どこに何を聞くか整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us distinguish who handles each matter and organize what to ask whom.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここでは郵便の転居方法を聞き、荷物は案内の会社名を確かめて連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 窓口では郵便手続きを聞き荷物は会社名を確認して連絡すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here I will ask about the postal change-of-address procedure, and for the parcel I will check the company name in the delivery information and contact them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask about postal procedures at this counter and check the parcel company's name before contacting it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認する相手を整理してから進めてください。郵便の受付担当へご案内しますので、私は案内を終えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40219-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please organize whom you need to check with before proceeding. I will direct you to the postal reception staff, so that concludes my guidance.
